display.name: Delta-Neutral Basis
display.description:
Market-neutral carry. The book is held delta-flat: every perp leg is offset, and returns come from funding-rate differentials and basis convergence rather than price direction. Manager capital and depositor principal are contributed roughly 1:1, aligning the manager's downside precisely with depositors'.

Exit threshold sits mid-range (1.50x). With no net directional exposure, realised variance is dominated by funding volatility and execution slippage rather than spot moves. Vault-level withdrawal throttling is enabled so a crowded exit cannot force liquidation of the offsetting legs at unfavourable prices.
